skill_AnimalHandling_description: Increased taming speed, loot and slaughtering loot, and no biome restrictions for bees. Higher levels unlock better perks.
skill_Voyager_description: The speed and skill with which you maneuver your boat.
skill_Hauling_description: Your ability to carry, store and transport goods.
skill_Forging_description: Your mastery of the forge. Improves your crafting stations and your odds at the Forge of Potential, and at higher levels lets you craft masterwork and lightweight equipment.
taming_feed_not_ready: {0} will eat from your hand again in {1}s
taming_feed_frightened: {0} is too frightened to eat from your hand
perk_woodcutting_damage_description: Your chops deal more damage to trees.
perk_woodcutting_yield_description: Trees and bushes drop more wood, resin and seeds.
perk_mining_damage_description: Your pickaxe deals more damage, so rock and ore break faster.
perk_mining_yield_description: Rocks and ore drop more stone and ore.
perk_taming_speed_description: Creatures you are taming tame faster.
perk_hand_feeding_description: Feeding a creature you are taming from your hotbar speeds up its taming, more so at higher levels.
perk_slaughter_loot_description: Tamed creatures drop more loot when slaughtered.
perk_farming_luck_description: Plants sometimes give extra produce when picked.
perk_scythe_reach_description: The scythe harvests a wider area.
perk_planting_stamina_description: Planting and cultivating cost less stamina.
perk_crew_speed_description: Every sailor aboard adds a little speed to the boat, more the higher their own skill.
perk_exploration_description: You reveal more of the map around you while sailing.
perk_cart_weight_description: Carts you pull are lighter and easier to move.
perk_bow_draw_description: Holding a bow drawn drains less stamina.
perk_distance_xp_description: Hits on distant targets give more XP.
perk_food_decay_description: Food you eat keeps its full effect for longer.
perk_cooking_streak_description: Cooking several foods in a row gives more XP for each one.
unlock_mining_crit_description: Swings sometimes land a critical hit for much more damage.
unlock_rockbreaker_description: Swings have a small chance to break a whole vein at once.
unlock_aoe_mining_description: Hits sometimes strike the rock and ore around them too.
unlock_fall_damage_description: You take less damage from falling.
unlock_safe_fall_description: You can fall further before taking damage.
unlock_better_bees_description: Beehives give more honey when you harvest them.
unlock_bees_anywhere_description: Beehives you build or look at make honey in any biome.
unlock_bonus_star_description: Creatures you tame or breed sometimes gain an extra star.
unlock_calm_taming_description: Creatures you are taming are not frightened by you while they have food, unless they are attacked.
unlock_growth_time_description: Looking at a plant shows roughly how long it has left to grow.
unlock_aoe_harvest_description: Picking a plant also picks the ones around it.
unlock_multiplant_description: Plant a grid of crops at once, which grows larger with your skill.
unlock_plant_anywhere_description: Plants you tend grow in any biome.
unlock_boat_damage_description: Your boat takes less damage while you are aboard.
unlock_sail_wind_description: Your sails catch the wind closer to head-on.
unlock_impact_resist_description: Your boat takes no damage from running into things.
unlock_quick_equip_description: Equipping and putting away items is faster.
unlock_crossbow_pause_description: Sprinting, jumping and dodging pause your reload instead of restarting it.
unlock_block_stamina_description: Blocking gives back part of the stamina it cost.
unlock_durability_saves_description: Weapons, tools and shields sometimes use no durability.
unlock_material_returns_description: Crafting and upgrading sometimes give back some of the materials.
unlock_bonus_cooking_description: Cooking at the cauldron sometimes makes extra food.
unlock_food_stamina_regen_description: The healing from food you have eaten also makes your stamina regenerate faster.
unlock_station_tier1_description: Workbenches and forges count as a higher level for you.
unlock_station_tier2_description: Black forges and galdr tables count as a higher level for you.
unlock_refinement_description: Refinements at the Forge of Potential succeed more often and are less likely to destroy the item.
forging_masterwork_description: Weapons, armor and shields you craft or upgrade are stronger.
forging_lightweight_description: Weapons, armor and shields you craft or upgrade weigh much less and slow you down less.
unlock_shield_reset_description: Recasting a shield on someone who already has one also restores how much damage it can absorb.
unlock_elemental_accuracy_description: Projectiles from elemental magic weapons spread less.
